basic_info.description:
This is an awesome value for a bright and clean 2 bedroom in a safe neighborhood, close to Ocean Beach and Sunset Blvd. Unit is on 2nd floor with a private entrance/gate and no one lives above you.

Space is good for two to three people. Living area comes in new flooring and is freshly painted.
Lots of natural lighting on top floor.

Kitchen comes with fridge and gas stove and plenty of cabinets and granite counter top. Bathroom with a window has a bathtub w/ vanity. Recently cleaned by a professional.

See last pic for unit layout.

Walgreens and laundromat is only one block away. Plenty of street parking 24/7.

Address: 2401 38th Ave x cross street Taraval
Rent: $3300 /mo
Available: Now

Location:
One block away from MUNI L Line stop to downtown and 2 blocks from 29 Bus which takes you to SFSU / Stonestown / CCSF /UCSF.

One year lease. No smoking and no pets allowed.
Security deposit: $3300.
Not to be used in lieu of last month's rent.
Owner pays for garbage, while tenant pays for gas, electric, and water.

Contact Chuck or Daisy for questions and availability for viewing.
If you are interested, please let us know what is your target move in date.

Plentiful street parking.
